t: Omerim parashat hattamid upesuqe qorban shabbat omerim etzel parashat hattamid
s: Omerim parashat hattamid upesuqe qorban shabbat omerim etzel parashat hattamid ubo g' seipim: nahagu kol yisrael veqabeu choba al atzman liqrot "parashat hattamid" bekol yom qodem hattepilla, sheal yede haqqeria zo — maaleh haqqadosh baruk hu alehem keillu hiqribu qorban tamid bemoado, kemo shennitbaer besiman a'. Vetob lomar gam parashat haqqetoret achar parashat hattamid, kemo shennitbaer sham. Veyesh nohagin lomar "abbayye hava mesadder seder hammaaraka veku'" ve"ribbon haolam veku'". Veim i epshar lomar hakkol betzibbur mippene shehatztzibbur en omerim ella parashat hattamid bilbad — yakol lomar hakkol bebeto mishsheyyeor hayyom, velachazor veliqrot parashat hattamid im hatztzibbur. Veen lachosh sheyyihyeh nireh kemaqrib b' temidin veober be"bal tosip", lepi shebbiqria en bah mishshum "bal tosip". Veal tzad hayyoter tob — yekavven bappaam hab' shehu keqore battora. Vetob lomar parashat haqqorbanot meummad — dugmat haqrabatan shehaya meummad:

Beshabbat nohagin lomar pesuqe qorban musap shabbat achar parashat hattamid. Veap al pi sheadayin lo hitpalelu shacharit veasur lehaqdim musap letamid shel shachar, mikkol maqom hare ameru kebar parashat hattamid, veim techasheb amirat happesuqim shel musap lehaqraba — gam amirat parashat hattamid nechsheba lehaqraba. Abal berosh chodesh veyom tob — en tzarik lehazkir pesuqe qorban musap etzel parashat tamid, mippene sheqqorin battora bipsuqe musap. Ubimdinot ellu nohagin shemmazkirin gam berosh chodesh, kede leparsem shehu rosh chodesh:

Nahagu hamdaqdeqim lehitnoea beshaa sheqqorin battora, dugmat hattora shennittena beretet kemo shekkatub: "vayyar haam vayyanuu vego'". Veken osin beshaa shemmitpalelin, al shem "kol atzmotay tomarna Hashem mi kamoka". Veyesh mi sheomerim sheen lehitnoea ella bipsuqe dezimra shehem shebach vehallel abal lo bitpillat y"ch, raq bachatimat habberakot nohagin qetzat lehitnoea benachat, leqayyem "mippene shemi nichat hu". Uleinyan maaseh, heak sheyyaaseh — yaaseh, ubilbad sheyyekavven:
